proposal.rationale: The root blocker pid 359475 has been idle in transaction for 4.1s (evidence [DB-1]). The business tolerates up to 60s of degraded checkout (evidence [BIZ-1]). Checkout has already seen 4 timeouts in the last 15s (evidence [TEL-1]), but waiting allows the blocker to finish naturally without forced termination, keeping blast radius minimal. No evidence suggests terminating protected_settlement is safe or effective; thus waiting is preferred.
proposal.expected_effect: The blocker's transaction will complete, releasing its locks. The checkout sessions waiting on the lock will then proceed, reducing timeouts. Checkout recovery expected within the 60s degraded window, keeping revenue at risk minimal.
proposal.risk_assessment: If the blocker's transaction takes longer than 60s, checkout may remain degraded beyond the business tolerance, increasing revenue loss. There is also a small risk the transaction could hang indefinitely, requiring later escalation.
